description: Local, offline text-to-speech and voice cloning on audio.cpp — multi-voice narration, voice design, sound/music generation, and a real-time conversational voice loop with a web UI. Runs on AMD (ROCm), NVIDIA (CUDA), Vulkan, or CPU.
